column1: # Sweep over per-try flip cutoff. cutoff = flips per try before inner restart
# (cache insert + assignment redraw + optional strategy randomization via
# --fixed). Smaller cutoff = more restarts = more cache churn + more
# diversification; larger cutoff = longer continuous search per try.
# Current default cutoff=20000. This sweep probes the curve up to 2.5M
# (~125x default) to see whether the historical 20K default is still right
# after all the recent perf and algorithm changes.
# Values: cutoff in {20K, 80K, 300K, 1M, 2.5M}. Name encodes cutoff in K.
